description: Agent Lab Open WebUI defaults. Applied via config/open-webui/apply-model-params.sh.
notes: think:false is the performance-critical default (Qwen reasoning can dominate max_tokens).
max_tokens maps to Ollama options.num_predict (Open WebUI payload remap).
Admin DEFAULT_MODEL_PARAMS alone may not bind on chat; apply-model-params also writes the same keys into the admin user's ui.params so the browser sends max_tokens every request.
Title/tags/follow-up/autocomplete/memory stay enabled (quiet-host isolation: ~0% main-reply impact when max_tokens is enforced).
Do NOT put think/num_predict in Advanced Params custom_params as strings; use Controls + ui.params.
num_ctx 4096 matches config/models.json inference.context for approved aliases.
